contentPattern.structure: full-bleed hero image (no overlay) + below-image article header: back-link + meta line (date / category / read-time) + title + dek

suitableFor: Our Stories editorial article headers (story-article template and -standard / -science / -media variants)
full-bleed image article banners where the title sits below the image on white
article intros that need a back-link and a date/category/read-time meta line
notSuitableFor: heroes with text overlaid on the image (use hero / hero-patient)
white-card-overlap heroes on dark navy sections (use hero-patient / hero-contact)
